text:
Alex DeBrincat, the Farmington Hills kid playing for his hometown team, scored 41 goals last season and came into this one with 294 for his career. Seven goals in 17 games looks like a slow start next to that. It isn't, really.

He has 64 shots on goal and 7.21 expected goals (the quality of his chances), so seven actual goals is right on schedule. He's shooting 10.9% against a typical 13.5%, and for a finisher like him that number tends to climb. Detroit also controls play when he's out there, with 58% of the 5v5 expected goals.

He matters beyond the score sheet. He ranks 13th of 496 skaters in wins added by goals, Evolving-Hockey had him sixth among 401 forwards last season at 3.5 wins above replacement, and USA Today has him in the conversation for the Red Wings' captaincy. A team video celebrated him and Patrick Kane being back together in Detroit. Our range says about 39 goals. The one cold spot: a single goal in his last seven games, on 25 shots.
headline: DeBrincat is doing the work, waiting on the goals
